title: Introduce SDK auth "junction" (credential multiplexing) and lightweight stream proxy across Py/TS/Go
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: multiple customers and platform teams reported brittle credential handoffs during long-lived streaming sessions, and we observed duplicated logic across Py/TS/Go SDKs for token refresh, prefetch, and fallback. This PR implements a small, portable 'junction' abstraction (credential multiplexing + hinting) and a lightweight stream proxy/facade to centralize session lifecycle, reduce duplication, and provide a predictable backoff surface for consumers.

What this does (single-string body): Adds a cross-SDK design pattern: a compact CredentialJunction that accepts multiple credential sources (static, delegated, KMS-backed refreshers) and exposes a uniform async/sync API to the stream runtime; introduces a StreamProxy layer that normalizes chunked stream events and exposes typed cursors/iterators in each SDK; unifies retry/backoff presets and telemetry tags used by streaming code paths so metrics and timeouts line up across languages; provides ergonomic factory functions for idiomatic usage in Python/TS/Go and small compatibility shims so existing callsites keep working. Includes tests, examples, and minimal docs.

Checklist: - [x] CredentialJunction implementation for Python/TypeScript/Go - [x] StreamProxy + typed cursor adapters - [x] Unified retry presets (lightweight templates) - [x] End-to-end smoke tests for reconnect/reauth scenarios - [x] Backward compatibility shims for v1.x SDK users - [x] Release notes

Backwards compatibility: Primary APIs are additive. Consumers using the older token callback will continue to function. We introduce new factory helpers (e.g., create_credential_junction, createStreamProxy) and exported types; none of the existing top-level client methods were removed. Migration guidance in release notes for teams who want the new ergonomics.

Implementation notes: The junction is intentionally minimal — it maintains an ordered list of sources and attempts a non-blocking refresh sweep ahead of token expiry. The StreamProxy aggregates small frames and exposes a resume token on drain to support deduplication on reconnects. Telemetry fields added: stream.session_id, cred.source_hint, cred.attempt_count.

Tests: unit tests for junction resolution logic, integration tests that spin up a local stream mock and simulate rotated credentials and intermittent network. CI matrix runs Py 3.11, Node 18, Go 1.21.

Related: ENG-2048 (streaming auth stability), ENG-2071 (cross-SDK ergonomics).

release_notes: Added CredentialJunction (multiplexed credential provider) and StreamProxy (normalized streaming facade) across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; unified streaming retry presets and telemetry; introduced factory helpers for easy adoption; small version bumps (py 1.13.0, ts 2.8.0, go 1.6.0). Backward compatible; opt-in ergonomics. See docs/sdk/migration/junction.md for migration steps and examples.

notes_for_release_manager: This PR adds new telemetry fields; ensure downstream dashboards include stream.session_id and cred.source_hint. Recommend a minor SDK release (semver minor) for Py/TS/Go and a coordinated announcement in the SDK changelog. No runtime migration required for existing apps, but recommend opt-in testing for long-lived streams.
